d390_boost.about: Boost pictures (HWUI's counter, compose-rs's session, the higher of both sessions' votes: effective_votes) and CPU by thread kind, per run (scenario-subject-run).

late_do_frames.about: doFrames starting more than 2 ms after their vsync, per run, as round 13's.

lazy_lists.about: compose-rs's lazy lists per scroll run, as round 13's.

prefetch_slices.about: Prefetch slices' main-thread work per scroll run, as round 13's.

hwui_workers.about: HWUI's workers' CPU time (ms) per stress_animation run.

note: Round 14, each: bench-rs (compose-rs at 3ac74a6) alone, at parity (subject rs: -e optimizations none) and with each optimization alone (rs+<name>), interleaved run by run. scroll, animation, stress_scroll: five invocations (each-0..4) of one traced run a subject, the 12 subjects' order rotated by 0, 2, 5, 7, 10 places. stress_animation: five invocations (each-sa-0..4) of parity and the four flags that can matter there (single_drawing_fade, flush_layers_before_dropped_paths, paragraph_render_nodes, performance_hint), rotated by 0 to 4; then a supplement (each-sb-0..2) of parity (subject rs@sb, its flags' reference) and the seven others, rotated by 0, 2, 3, stopped after three invocations as the device needed up to 240 s of cooling before each run (all 12 flags on this screen would have taken the round past about 3 hours). Every run started at thermal status 0, battery <= 34 C and skin <= 35 C (--battery-limit 34 --skin-limit 35 --thermal-wait-limit 0), our apps stopped while waiting. invocations: each one's subject order, thermal limits, APK checks and dexopt states. d390_boost, late_do_frames, lazy_lists, prefetch_slices, hwui_workers: the analyses, keyed scenario-subject-run, as the parity and all rounds'. Run on 2026-10-25 from 01:25 CEST to 03:36 CET (the clocks went back an hour at 03:00 CEST).

changes.about: Per scenario and subject: each metric's median over the runs, and for each flag its change against parity's median (change_pct; the supplement's flags against rs@sb) with an exact two-sided Mann-Whitney p over the runs; app_jank/compositor_jank: totals over the runs.
